open_items.reason: No run this round. T11 targets (median, kills): blood_death_knight 15,364.3 (6), survival_hunter 22,932.8 (9), fire_mage 18,701.95 (4), retribution_paladin 20,070.75 (4), assassination_rogue 20,705.9 (4), elemental_shaman 22,266.0 (8), demonology_warlock 20,471.5 (3); round-2 kills (409 gear) are not comparable.

10H/25N/25H stay blocked by six ledger claims (each lists its modes): hotfix carryover, cadence, target counts/samples (incl. Remedy ramp and slime strip, native on 10N only), 25N health and non-10N enrage, heroic Fixate and Black-first re-pull, non-10N add melee.

Native 10N Biting Chill now always lands on a melee-range player; the bot isolates a chilled non-tank when anyone is within 6 yd (BitingChillDanger), wider than the aura's 3-yd area, so melee may step out more than needed. Not tuned without live data.

risks: Remedy ramp (10N, once the binding is promoted): an undispelled Remedy heals about 1.375M (7% of 19.76M) instead of 250k. In the user's 50% hold nobody dispels, so Maloriak climbs during the hold; with a hold of ~75 s the kill can lengthen by ~20-30 s. The 10N Berserk (7 min) now bounds a stalled fight; round-2 kills took 194 s at 409 gear.

Pre-vial model (10N): the storm time is drawn from 19 observed begins; the Release/Remedy/vial choice uses empirical frequencies (early 1:1, late vial 5/8, Remedy 2/8, Release 1/8). After a pre-vial Release the throw comes 2.8 s after the Release begin (live 1.6-1.7 s) because the face event waits for the cast.
Growth Catalyst recast after the slime uses one observed 5.2 s sample; the Rend's early removals (2.8-4.9 s live) are not modelled (1,000 per 3 s).
Prime Subject 3.5 excludes 8 late QfJR rows whose Growth Catalyst counts are inflated by dying Aberrations (no remove rows); with them the bounds cross (3.394 vs 3.245, all-row mean 3.35).
Flash Freeze on 10N now prefers players beyond 10 yd of Maloriak; bots in the Blue back fan (18 yd) will be the targets, as in the WCL kills.

Chrome exited during the first parallel WCL batch (plugin: no browser); I relaunched it with the user's profile (google-chrome --profile-directory='Profile 1', DISPLAY :0) at 10:50 UTC. Other agents' WCL tasks were affected at the same time.
New source file boss_maloriak_minions.cpp needs a CMake reconfigure (patch request); boss_maloriak.cpp is now 728 lines.
validation_neutrality: All native changes are gated to 10N (GetDifficulty()/IsTenNormal checks or the 10N-only spell id binding) and to Maloriak's own scripts and entries; the file split moves code verbatim. The shared bot code, other bosses, Stonecore, dummy calibration and Magmaw's accepted scope are untouched (BotMaloriakDuties.h changed a comment only). The staged SQL touches only creature_template 41440/41841 and spell_script_names 77912.
